description: Loot is a separate layer for block/furniture drops. Preserve source loot table structure; full vanilla-style loot DSL as-is.
drop_loot_function: drop_loot event function can force-execute a loot table with to_inventory option.
note: CE's loot entry registry is LootEntryContainers (alternatives, if_else, item, exp, furniture_item, empty, function, loot_table). Its loot function registry has six native functions: apply_bonus, apply_data, set_count, explosion_decay, drop_exp and limit_count. Other vanilla datapack entries/functions are not inventable; the generator maps well-known equivalents or reports them as manual tasks.
